system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Amateur Radio (Ham Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-savvy hobbyists, licensed radio operators who legally must log contacts, often older with disposable income, proud of their call signs and technical setup.
product_angles: Highly functional, beautiful Contact Logbooks (KDP) with dedicated columns for UTC, Frequency, Mode, Power, and QSL card tracking
Vintage schematic or patent-style technical schematics of historical radios on apparel/mugs (Redbubble)
3D printable custom radio mounts or wire antenna insulators (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: Premium Ham Radio Logbook (KDP) with a vintage 1920s patent schematic cover and optimized high-density grid interior

proposals.name: Rope Access Technicians (Cordistes)
proposals.buyer_persona: High-altitude industrial workers (wind turbines, skyscrapers, bridges) who view themselves as extreme athletes. They love sharing insider memes, specialized gear references, and high-risk pride.
product_angles: Sarcastic physics and gravity-related humor stickers (Redbubble)
Daily Inspection & Log Book for Rope Access Gear (KDP) - tailored to IRATA/SPRAT standards
proposals.first_test_product: Rope Access Daily Equipment Log & Rigging Journal (KDP) with a rugged, high-contrast tactical cover

proposals.name: PS1-Style / Low-Poly Retro Gamedev Assets
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers building horror, sci-fi, or retro games inspired by late 90s console aesthetics. They need lightweight, stylistically coherent assets fast.
product_angles: Low-poly modular retro dungeon/corridor assets in OBJ/FBX format (Gamedev asset pack)
Dithered, low-resolution pixelated texture packs (Sci-Fi / Industrial theme)
Retro user interface (UI) pixel-art icon packs
proposals.first_test_product: Retro 90s Industrial Corridor Asset Pack (30 low-poly FBX models with dithered 256x256 textures generated via Together AI/Flux and downscaled)

proposals.name: Aquascaping & High-Tech Planted Tanks
proposals.buyer_persona: Obsessive aquarium hobbyists balancing water chemistry (pH, GH, KH, CO2) and plant aesthetics. Willing to spend hundreds on rare plants and pristine gear.
product_angles: Aquascaping Layout Sketchbook & Water Parameter Tracker (KDP) with grid pages for hardscape design
Minimalist aesthetic vector art of rare aquatic plants (Bucephalandra, Anubias) on t-shirts/mugs (Redbubble)
3D printable low-profile aquarium rim lid clips or moss-growing ledges (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: The Aquascaper's Journal: 52-Week Water Parameter Tracker & Hardscape Planner (KDP)

proposals.name: Solarpunk Aesthetic Game UI & Visual Assets
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie creators, visual novel writers, and tabletop RPG worldbuilders looking for eco-optimistic, high-tech, stained-glass, and plant-integrated visual styles.
product_angles: Solarpunk UI Kit: buttons, borders, and frames featuring brass, glass, and leaf motifs (PNG/SVG assets)
High-definition Solarpunk city/interior background packs for visual novels
Solarpunk-themed tabletop RPG character sheet templates (PDF/Digital download)
proposals.first_test_product: Solarpunk Visual Novel Background Pack (15 high-quality generated images from Together AI FLUX-schnell, upscaled and curated)

proposals.name: Ortholinear & Split Mechanical Keyboard Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Software engineers, writers, and ergonomic nerds obsessed with custom layouts (Dactyl ManuForm, Corne, Planck). They love desk aesthetics and highly technical schematics.
product_angles: Ortholinear keycap layout planner and macro mapping notebook (KDP)
Aesthetic technical deskmats featuring split keyboard wiring diagrams (Redbubble/Printify)
3D printable custom travel cases or tilting stands for Corne/Lily58 keyboards (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: Corne Keyboard Ergonomic Tilting Stand (3D printable STL files with adjustable angles on Cults3D)
